how.title: How JobGambit writes your CV and cover letter

steps.start: Every application starts from your master CV (Profile › Your CV), never from an earlier tailored CV.
steps.tailor: One AI pass reads the posting and your CV, follows your CV and letter instructions, and suggests: a short profile, reworded lines (only lines that exist in your CV), which projects to show, the order of lines and skills, and the letter.
steps.review: A second AI pass reads it like a hiring manager: it sharpens the wording, lists what the posting asks for that isn't covered, and flags anything that claims more than your CV says.
steps.you: You decide on every card. Flagged lines keep your own wording unless you accept them. Nothing is added that isn't in your CV: no new jobs, projects or skills.
steps.checks: The PDFs are checked: page count, text that hiring software can read, banned phrases, and numbers that are neither in your CV nor the posting (these block the document); unknown tool names and big claims (these warn).
steps.learn: What you corrected becomes a lesson for the next application, and wordings you approved are offered again where they fit.
